headline: Zul'Gurub with 13 people, cleared with one Hakkar wipe at 6%

mvp.headline: the most damage on five of the nine bosses
why: First on Venoxis, Mar'li, Mandokir, Wushoolay and Jin'do, second on Jeklik, Arlokk and Hakkar
3 interrupts, one of them a Great Heal

also.text: 8 interrupts, the most, and the most damage on Jeklik, Thekal, Arlokk and Hakkar
the most healing on Venoxis, Mar'li, Mandokir and Thekal, 48% of it on Venoxis
96 dispels, 34 of them Curse of Blood

overview: Thirteen raiders, no world buffs, nine kills in 1:19:29 against a usual 52 minutes. Raid damage ran at 37% to 85% of a usual 20-man kill, so every boss took longer than usual and the attrition mechanics had more time to work.
Hakkar wiped once at 6% and died on the next pull. A pack of Mad Voidwalkers killed 8 at the 34 minute mark.

wipes.title: Hakkar, pull 1 (6%)
wipes.whatHappened: A 4:34 fight. Corrupted Blood killed Pomo at 3:15, then Hakkar killed Mercîless (tanking) at 3:22. Mind-controlled tanks killed two healers: Macharius hit Yuleblessing at 3:37 and Alanakos Künigünde at 4:17. Corrupted Blood took Terrora, Fluffycatto, Gael and Yulepunch.
wipes.likelyCause: Most likely Corrupted Blood spreading between players standing close, over a long fight: 85 hits, 6.5 per raider, against about 2 on a usual kill. With the tanks mind-controlled 11 times, two healers went down and the raid couldn't hold the last 6%.
evidence: 5 deaths to Corrupted Blood, against almost none on a usual kill
12 mind controls, 11 of them on the tanks (Mercîless and Macharius 4 each, Alanakos 3)
Raid DPS 3.0k against 5.7k on a usual kill
wipes.avoid: Spread wider for Corrupted Blood, and control the mind-controlled tank before it reaches a healer.

wentWell.text: Hakkar pull 2 in 3:37 with no deaths, Corrupted Blood down to 51 hits.
Jeklik's one Great Heal kicked by Tochopolvo.

notes.text: 0:56 (median 0:48), no deaths. Foggiie did 48% of the healing.
1:40 (median 0:57), no deaths. Her Drain Life healed her for 76k, against a usual 23k.
2:48 (median 1:19), 3 deaths: Yulepunch to Guillotine at 0:45, Gael to Mortal Strike at 2:03 and Alanakos, tanking, at 2:12. Whirlwind hits at two and a half times the usual rate.
Wushoolay in 1:03, no deaths. Lightning Cloud did a third of all damage taken.
2:16. Macharius died to Thekal's melee at 2:14, just before the kill. 2 of 3 Great Heals kicked.
1:44 (median 0:33), no deaths, raid damage at 37% of a usual kill.
Pull 1 wiped at 6%. See the wipe above.
